concept: Farm meets Future - High-end agritech marketplace merging earthy trust with transparent blockchain analytics.

mono.usage: Blockchain transactions, wallet addresses, AI confidence scores.

hierarchy_rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.

rules: Use #2D5A3F (Deep Moss) for structural elements and main CTAs.
Use #CCFF00 (Volt/Chartreuse) sparingly for blockchain trust indicators, active states, and to break the organic feel with a high-tech punch.
Never use pure #000000; use #1A2E20 for pure darks.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) with strict grid structures. No soft dropshadow cards.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: 'Control Room' - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6. Children must stretch h-full.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.surface_styles: Use 'Grid Borders' pattern. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-black/10), NO shadow. Hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border darkens to border-black/30.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and headings. Avoid center alignment unless for specific marketing hero text.

components_and_interactions.buttons: Flat, pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Hover state MUST explicitly change text and background color.
components_and_interactions.voice_interface: Floating action button (FAB) locked to bottom right, pulsing border (The 'Tracing Beam' effect) when listening.
components_and_interactions.animations: Framer motion for page transitions. Staggered list reveals. 'prefers-reduced-motion' must be respected.
components_and_interactions.data_viz: Recharts for analytics. D3 only if showing complex supply-chain node graphs. Use #2D5A3F and #CCFF00 for chart colors.
components_and_interactions.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='voice-command-btn', data-testid='escrow-pay-btn').

image_urls.description: Lush green agricultural field at sunrise with subtle glowing digital nodes, representing advanced agritech and blockchain. Use for the main landing/marketing page hero section. Add bg-black/30 overlay if placing text on top.
Abstract topographical map. Use as a subtle watermark or header background for the Admin/Buyer dashboard.
3D trust shield blending with a green leaf. Use for the Consumer Trust Meter or Blockchain Verification sections.
Senior farmer portrait. Use in the Buyer Dashboard when viewing 'Nearby Farmers' or on the video call verification screen mockups.
Basket of fresh vegetables. Use for the Consumer Marketplace product cards or Farmer Dashboard registered crops.

rules: Images on mobile MUST NOT exceed 80vh.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com.
If text overlays an image, use a text-shadow or gradient overlay for contrast.

icons_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react for standard UI, phosphor-icons for data/dashboard density if needed.
icons_and_libraries.animations_lib: framer-motion for layout transitions and the pulsing voice UI.
icons_and_libraries.charts: recharts (Shadcn UI charts) for market trends and trust score history.

page_specific_instructions.farmer_app: Optimize for extreme ease of use. Huge buttons, stark contrast. Voice command is the primary interaction - show a prominent, glowing microphone FAB. Minimal text; rely on icons and spoken feedback (mocked).
page_specific_instructions.buyer_dashboard: High data density using the 'Grid Borders' style. Filterable tables for smart search. Video verification UI needs a prominent call-to-action.
page_specific_instructions.consumer_marketplace: Bento grid layout focusing on the journey of the crop. QR scan trigger, displaying the 'trust_badge_icon' prominently.
page_specific_instructions.admin_engine: Complex analytics dashboard. Use Recharts for fraud detection metrics. Use the 'abstract_topo_dashboard' background in the header for a premium feel.
